summary: BlueOne Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, disclosing a change in its certifying accountant: it dismissed Salberg Company, P.A. and engaged Dylan Floyd Accounting Consulting as its independent registered public accounting firm. The filing notes no disagreements or reportable events during the relevant periods, except that prior audit reports contained going-concern explanatory paragraphs. This is a routine auditor change disclosure, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, activist activity, strategic review, or other transformative events. No further action or analysis is warranted.
